entry.description: Explains body-language physically when the text signals a feeling.
entry.childHint: A racing heart usually shows a feeling. Check what the character is feeling right then.
entry.approvalNote: Cleared on the printed review pack; returned marked up.

stem.text: Read lines 5 to 9. Why did the Mole suddenly stop cleaning and run outside?

carriers.key: Spring outside was pulling at him and he could not sit still.

options.value: He had finished every job in the house.
Spring outside was pulling at him and he could not sit still.
His back and arms hurt too much to go on.
options.execution: Line 4 gives the aching back and weary arms — a physical state offered in place of the pull of spring at lines 5 and 6.

options.value: The Water Rat called him from up above.
He wanted to find the river he had heard about.
